avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance immune stimulation, potentially counteracting belimumab's immunosuppressive effects and reducing therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; educate patient on immunostimulant avoidance

avoid_supplements.name: Astragalus
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent immune stimulant that may antagonize belimumab's B-cell suppression mechanism
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use prior to belimumab therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May stimulate immune function and reduce immunosuppressive efficacy of belimumab
avoid_supplements.action: Counsel patient to avoid or monitor for reduced therapeutic response

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modulate gut-associated lymphoid tissue; generally safe but monitor clinical response
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously and maintain consistent product/strain; report any changes in disease activity

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: May support immune regulation; beneficial in SLE patients but monitor levels during belimumab therapy
caution_supplements.action: Supplementation generally appropriate; monitor serum levels periodically

caution_foods.name: High-sodium diet
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate lupus nephritis and fluid retention, particularly relevant in SLE patients on belimumab
caution_foods.action: Recommend sodium restriction consistent with SLE management guidelines

monitoring_notes: Belimumab is a monoclonal antibody with no significant hepatic or renal metabolism; primary concern is avoiding immunostimulant supplements that may reduce efficacy. Monitor for infection risk and ensure vaccination status is current prior to therapy initiation, as concurrent immunostimulants increase infection complications.
